wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
This symbol is WILD and substitutes for all symbols.
 Whenever a WILD symbol hits, there is a chance that the total win of the
 spin is multiplied by a random multiplier of 5X, 8X and 10X.
 If two WILD symbols hit along with a blank, the reel containing the blank
 re-spins until a wining combination hits.
